items.sum: Veteran music composer Deva, known to fans as Thenisai Thendral, died at the age of 76 in a Chennai hospital on Saturday, 17 October, following age-related health complications. He made his debut in 1989 with Manasukketha Maharasa and composed for over 400 films, creating iconic soundtracks for blockbusters like Annamalai, Baashha, and Kaadhal Kottai, while successfully popularising gaana music in mainstream Tamil cinema. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and DMK president MK Stalin paid glowing tributes, with Stalin noting, "Tamil popular music history cannot be written without Deva."
